Constant maximum allowed timelock delay (30 days).

Deploys the timelock, validating delay bounds and initializing admin, delay and admin_initialized.

Transfers admin rights to pendingAdmin when called by pendingAdmin.
Sets pendingAdmin; first call allowed by admin, later calls only by the timelock itself.
Admin-only. Hashes transaction parameters, enforces eta >= now + delay and marks txHash as queued.
Admin-only. Hashes transaction parameters and marks txHash as not queued.
Admin-only. Validates queued state and timelock window, clears the queue flag and performs a low-level call to target.
Internal helper returning block.timestamp (stub kept for testing/override).

edges.reason: setDelay requires msg.sender == address(this); caller identity gates the state change.
acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin and then assigns admin.
setPendingAdmin branches on msg.sender to decide timelock vs first-admin authorization.
queueTransaction requires msg.sender == admin.
cancelTransaction requires msg.sender == admin.
executeTransaction requires msg.sender == admin before performing the external call.
getBlockTimestamp returns block.timestamp, the timestamp source for all delay checks.
eta >= getBlockTimestamp().add(delay) makes queueing dependent on block.timestamp.
Execution window checks compare block.timestamp against eta and eta.add(GRACE_PERIOD).
Constructor parameter admin_ is assigned to the admin state variable.
Constructor parameter delay_ is bounds-checked and assigned to delay.
setDelay parameter delay_ is validated and written to storage.
setPendingAdmin parameter pendingAdmin_ is written to the pendingAdmin state variable.
target is hashed into txHash.
value is hashed into txHash.
signature is hashed into txHash.
data is hashed into txHash.
eta is hashed into txHash and compared against now + delay.
target is hashed into the cancelled txHash.
value is hashed into the cancelled txHash.
signature is hashed into the cancelled txHash.
data is hashed into the cancelled txHash.
eta is hashed into the cancelled txHash.
target is hashed and used as the low-level call destination.
value is hashed and forwarded in the low-level call.
signature is hashed and encoded into callData selector.
data is hashed and encoded into callData.
eta is hashed and compared against the current timestamp and grace period.
add operand a flows into the checked addition.
add operand b flows into the checked addition.
sub operand a forwarded to the checked subtraction.
sub operand b forwarded to the checked subtraction.
sub operand a used in the require and subtraction.
sub operand b used in the require and subtraction.
errorMessage is propagated to the reverting require.
mul operand a used in the zero shortcut and checked multiplication.
mul operand b used in the overflow check and multiplication.
div operand a forwarded to the checked division.
div operand b forwarded to the checked division.
div operand a used in the division.
div operand b required non-zero and used as divisor.
errorMessage is propagated to the reverting require.
mod operand a forwarded to the checked modulo.
mod operand b forwarded to the checked modulo.
mod operand a used in the modulo expression.
mod operand b required non-zero and used as divisor.
errorMessage is propagated to the reverting require.
Local c holds the checked sum returned by add.
Local c holds the checked difference returned by sub.
Local c holds the checked product returned by mul.
Local c holds the checked quotient returned by div.
Local txHash is computed from the parameters and written into queuedTransactions.
Local txHash is computed from the parameters and cleared in queuedTransactions.
Local txHash gates execution and is cleared before the external call.
Local callData is built from signature and data and passed to the low-level call.
Local success is required to be true after the low-level call.
Local returnData is returned from executeTransaction.
Constructor writes the admin state variable.
Constructor writes the delay state variable.
Constructor initializes admin_initialized to false.
setDelay overwrites the delay state variable.
acceptAdmin assigns admin = msg.sender.
acceptAdmin resets pendingAdmin to address(0).
setPendingAdmin writes the pendingAdmin state variable.
First setPendingAdmin call flips admin_initialized to true.
queueTransaction reads delay when validating eta.
queueTransaction writes true into queuedTransactions[txHash].
cancelTransaction writes false into queuedTransactions[txHash].
executeTransaction reads GRACE_PERIOD for the staleness check.
executeTransaction reads and then clears queuedTransactions[txHash].
queueTransaction calls getBlockTimestamp to obtain the current time.
executeTransaction calls getBlockTimestamp for the timelock and grace checks.
queueTransaction invokes SafeMath.add on the timestamp.
executeTransaction invokes SafeMath.add on eta with GRACE_PERIOD.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) forwards to the message-carrying variant.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256) forwards to the message-carrying variant.
SafeMath.mod(uint256,uint256) forwards to the message-carrying variant.
executeTransaction performs an arbitrary low-level external call to target with attacker/admin supplied calldata and value.
The external call can re-enter the timelock (e.g. acceptAdmin/queueTransaction) while executeTransaction is still on the stack.
